Commanders ​

Tools for managing deck commanders and color identity.

manage_commander ​

Add, remove, or swap commanders for a Commander format deck.

ParamTypeRequiredDescription
actionstringyesadd, remove, or swap
deck_idstringyesDeck UUID
commander_namestringyesCommander card name
set_codestringnoSet code
collector_numberstringnoCollector number
forcebooleannoSkip name/set mismatch check
new_commander_namestringswapNew commander name (swap only)
new_set_codestringnoSet code for new commander (swap only)
new_collector_numberstringnoCollector number for new commander (swap only)

Response:

json
{
  "success": true,
  "commanders": ["Atraxa, Praetors' Voice"],
  "colorIdentity": ["W", "U", "B", "G"]
}
